blocks.text: Short-form `depends_on` only orders container starts; waiting for a dependency to be usable requires a healthcheck plus `condition: service_healthy` (or `service_completed_successfully` for one-shot jobs).

blocks.code:
services:
  db:
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 20s
  migrate:
    command: ["alembic", "upgrade", "head"]
    depends_on: { db: { condition: service_healthy } }
    restart: "no"
  api:
    depends_on:
      db: { condition: service_healthy, restart: true }
      migrate: { condition: service_completed_successfully }

items: Applies only during `docker compose up`; runtime restarts or failovers aren't covered.
`service_healthy` without a healthcheck is an error.

blocks.text: Q: "Does depends_on wait for Postgres to be ready?" A: "Not by default. The short form only orders starts. Use a healthcheck with condition: service_healthy, and still add retries in the app, because nothing waits at runtime or in Kubernetes."
